project_type: React 18 SPA with Vite, TypeScript strict mode, Zustand state, Supabase backend
build_system: Vite + npm, top-level Makefile delegates to frontend/
build_command: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit
test_command: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest --run
verification_instructions: 1. Run typecheck: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit. 2. Run tests: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest --run. All 673+ tests must pass.
setup_instructions: cd frontend && npm ci (already done, node_modules exists). NOTE: Must use 'unset NODE_OPTIONS' before running node commands due to sandbox preload issue.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network. Must unset NODE_OPTIONS before running vitest/tsc due to proxy-bootstrap.js preload issue in sandbox. No Docker daemon needed.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing panel pattern: {FeatureName}Panel.tsx + Add{Item}Dialog.tsx + index.ts + __tests__/ directory. DESIGNER-mode-only visibility check. Use fromTable() from @/lib/supabase for DB queries. Use data-testid attributes for all interactive elements.
key_patterns: 1. Panel components: standalone, receive templateId prop, check CanvasMode.DESIGNER, use fromTable() for CRUD. 2. Dialog components: fixed overlay, form fields, confirm/cancel buttons, error display. 3. Tests: vi.mock @/lib/supabase and @/stores/authStore, import component after mocks, use waitFor for async data. 4. Types: MountingType already in engines/types.ts as 'DIRECT'|'PROFILE'|'COVE'. SkuCompatibility interface in types/database.ts. 5. Index files: re-export Panel + Dialog.
directory_structure: frontend/src/components/{FeatureName}/ - each feature has Panel.tsx, Dialog.tsx, index.ts, __tests__/. frontend/src/engines/ - calculation engines. frontend/src/types/ - database.ts, canvas.ts. frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand stores. frontend/src/lib/ - supabase.ts helper.
